definitions.gloss: to hit it off, to get along instantly
definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom describing the instant rapport and mutual understanding that develops between people when they first meet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初対面|しょたいめん}→初対面：07306_shotaimen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{意気投合|いきとうごう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We hit it off at first meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧で{意気投合|いきとうごう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We bonded over having the same hobbies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{意気投合|いきとうごう}して⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The two hit it off and started a business together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧{意気投合|いきとうごう}して⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: They immediately hit it off and became best friends.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧)

LITERAL MEANING: ⟦{意気|いき}→意気：noentry⟧ (spirit, will) + ⟦{投合|とうごう}→投合：noentry⟧ (to come together, to harmonize) = Spirits coming together in harmony.

USAGE PATTERNS:
・{意気投合|いきとうごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to hit it off)
・{意気投合|いきとうごう}して＋verb (after hitting it off, ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{初対面|しょたいめん}→初対面：07306_shotaimen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{意気投合|いきとうごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to hit it off at first meeting)
・⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧{意気投合|いきとうごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to immediately get along)
・{意気投合|いきとうごう}して⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become friends after hitting it off)

NUANCE: Always positive, describing a natural and mutual connection between people.

ENGLISH EQUIVALENTS:
・To hit it off
・To click
・To connect immediately

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ - to get along well (literally: horses match)
・⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ - to be compatible, to get along
・⟦{仲良|なかよ}く→仲良い：29434_nakayoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - to become close/friendly
